articles.summary: Avantor, Inc. (NYSE: AVTR), a leading global provider of mission-critical products and services to customers in the life sciences and advanced technology industries, will release its third quarter 2026 financial results before the market opens on Wednesday, October 28, and will hold a related conference call on the same day at 8:00 a.m. Eastern Time. To hear a live audio webcast of the session, visit News Events in the Investor section of Avantor's website, ir.avantorsciences.com . A replay of the webcast will be available for 30 days. About Avantor Avantor ® is a leading life science tools company and global provider of mission-critical products and services to the life sciences and advanced technology industries. We work side-by-side with customers at every step of the scientific journey to enable breakthroughs in medicine, healthcare, and technology.
